products.title: Grey & Red Tartan Check Harris Tweed® Headcovers
products.body_html:
Grey & Red Tartan Check Harris Tweed® Headcovers

What's Included - This Harris tweed range is available in:

Standard Headcovers: Driver, Wood, Hybrid, Alignment Stick, Blade Putter

Barrel Headcovers: Driver, Wood

The Essence of Luxury Golf Accessories - At Clamp Golf Company, we take immense pride in providing the perfect blend of style, durability, and functionality through our bespoke golf headcovers. Expertly handcrafted from start to finish, each piece is a testament to our unwavering commitment to quality and style.

Materials - Our Harris Tweed Headcovers are crafted from Harris Tweed created in the outer Hebrides of Scotland, made with a black genuine leather hide backing and matching inner fleece lining.

Durable Stitching - The construction of our golf headcovers is marked by exceptional attention to detail. We use nylon bonded thread - one of the toughest threads available - to provide robust, resilient stitching. This ensures your headcover withstands the test of time and maintains its shape and structure, regardless of the conditions on the course.

Inner Lining - A soft inner lining of fleece providing optimal protection to your clubs. This plush lining guards against scratches and dents, making sure your gear remains in pristine condition.

Fit - All of our headcovers are designed and made to fit all makes and models.

Craftsmanship - At Clamp Golf Company, every headcover is not just a product, but a piece of art, meticulously crafted by our in-house artisans. This combination of handpicked materials, unmatched sewing proficiency, and refined design aesthetics makes each piece a unique addition to your collection.
